elden-ring.desc: FromSoftware's open-world action RPG set in the Lands Between, with punishing combat, deep build variety and a world designed with George R. R. Martin.

elden-ring-nightreign.desc: A standalone co-operative spin-off on Elden Ring's combat, built around three-player runs against a shrinking map and a nightly boss.

cyberpunk-2077.desc: An open-world RPG in Night City where you build a mercenary, upgrade with cyberware and shape the story through branching choices.

witcher-3.desc: Geralt of Rivia hunts monsters across a vast fantasy world in this story-driven RPG, bundled here with both major expansions.

baldurs-gate-3.desc: A turn-based Dungeons & Dragons RPG with a party of distinctive companions and an enormous amount of reactive, branching story.

diablo-iv.desc: An always-online action RPG through the shared world of Sanctuary, with five classes, seasonal content and loot-driven progression.

hogwarts-legacy.desc: An open-world adventure set in the 1800s wizarding world, mixing spell-casting combat, potions, creatures and castle exploration.

jedi-survivor.desc: Cal Kestis returns in a single-player action adventure with multiple lightsaber stances, Force powers and large explorable planets.

star-wars-outlaws.desc: An open-world scoundrel adventure across Star Wars planets, blending stealth, blaster fights, speeder travel and space dogfights.

ac-mirage.desc: A tighter, stealth-focused Assassin's Creed set in ninth-century Baghdad, returning to parkour, social blending and hidden-blade assassinations.

ac-shadows.desc: Feudal Japan through two playable leads: a stealthy shinobi and a heavyweight samurai, with seasons that change the open world.

ac-valhalla.desc: Lead a Viking clan settling in England, raiding monasteries, building a settlement and fighting through a long open-world saga.

re4.desc: Capcom's remake of the survival horror classic: Leon's rescue mission in rural Spain, rebuilt with modern controls and reworked encounters.

re-village.desc: First-person survival horror in a snowbound village of lycans and noble houses, continuing Ethan Winters' story from Resident Evil 7.

dead-space.desc: A ground-up remake of the sci-fi horror original aboard the USG Ishimura, built around strategic dismemberment and zero-gravity dread.

callisto.desc: Brutal, cinematic survival horror inside a prison on Jupiter's moon Callisto, mixing melee brawling with body-horror creature design.

silent-hill-2.desc: Bloober Team's remake of the psychological horror landmark, following James Sunderland into a fog-choked town built from his own guilt.

dbd.desc: Asymmetric multiplayer horror: four survivors repair generators and escape while one player hunts them as an iconic killer.

it-takes-two.desc: A co-op-only adventure for two players, inventing new mechanics in every chapter as a splitting couple is shrunk to doll size.

split-fiction.desc: A two-player co-op adventure from the makers of It Takes Two, jumping between two writers' sci-fi and fantasy worlds.

forza-horizon-5.desc: An open-world racing festival across a vibrant map of Mexico, with hundreds of cars, seasonal events and a generous handling model.

f1-24.desc: Official Formula 1 racing with the 2024 grid, a driver career mode, reworked handling and full multiplayer championships.

ea-wrc.desc: The official World Rally Championship game: point-to-point stages, long career progression and a rally car builder.

nfs-unbound.desc: Street racing with a graffiti-styled art direction, high-risk day-and-night wager events and heavy visual customisation.

acc.desc: A focused GT racing simulator built on the Blancpain series, with demanding physics, tyre modelling and endurance-style events.

ea-fc-25.desc: Football with licensed leagues and clubs, Ultimate Team, career mode and the 5v5 Rush format.

nba-2k25.desc: Basketball simulation with MyCAREER, MyTEAM and refreshed dribbling and shooting systems across licensed NBA and WNBA teams.

wwe-2k24.desc: Wrestling with a large roster, a WrestleMania-themed showcase mode, universe management and a deep creation suite.

cities-skylines-2.desc: A large-scale city builder with detailed road tools, zoning, traffic simulation and citizens modelled individually.

civ-7.desc: Turn-based 4X strategy across three historical ages, letting you change civilisation as your empire evolves.

tww3.desc: Real-time battles and turn-based empire management in the Warhammer world, with huge armies, monsters and campaign magic.

aoe4.desc: Historical real-time strategy with distinctive civilisations, castle-age sieges and documentary-style campaigns.

frostpunk-2.desc: A bleak city-survival strategy game about governing a frozen metropolis, balancing heat, resources and political factions.

stellaris.desc: A grand strategy space 4X about exploring, colonising and governing a galaxy-spanning empire full of emergent events.

coh3.desc: Squad-based real-time strategy in the Mediterranean theatre, with cover-driven tactics and a dynamic Italian campaign map.

helldivers-2.desc: A chaotic third-person co-op shooter where four-player squads drop onto hostile planets with stratagems and heavy friendly fire.

doom-eternal.desc: Fast, aggressive first-person combat that pushes you to keep moving, chain resources and use the right weapon on every demon.

doom-dark-ages.desc: A medieval-flavoured Doom prequel with heavier, grounded combat, a shield saw and large-scale battlefields.

bf2042.desc: Large-scale multiplayer warfare with vehicles, destructive weather events and big class-based conquest maps.

gow-ragnarok.desc: Kratos and Atreus face the coming of Ragnarök in a story-driven action adventure across the Norse realms.

spider-man-2.desc: Swing across a larger New York as both Peter Parker and Miles Morales, with the symbiote suit reshaping combat.

ghost-of-tsushima.desc: An open-world samurai adventure during the Mongol invasion, with stance-based duelling and the Iki Island expansion included.

horizon-fw.desc: Aloy travels west through ruined America hunting machine creatures, with the Burning Shores expansion included.

tlou-1.desc: A rebuilt version of the post-apocalyptic survival drama following Joel and Ellie across a collapsed United States.

returnal.desc: A third-person roguelike shooter where each death restarts a hostile alien planet with new weapons and layouts.

sea-of-thieves.desc: A shared-world pirate adventure: sail with a crew, hunt treasure, fight skeletons and risk everything to other players.

forza-motorsport.desc: Circuit racing simulation with a career built on practice and car upgrades, dynamic time of day and detailed track modelling.

halo-infinite.desc: Master Chief returns in a semi-open campaign on Zeta Halo, alongside the free-to-play arena multiplayer.

starfield.desc: Bethesda's space RPG: build a character and a ship, explore settled systems and take on faction questlines.

grounded.desc: Survival crafting shrunk to insect scale in a suburban back garden, playable solo or with friends.

monster-hunter-wilds.desc: Hunt huge monsters in living ecosystems, then craft their parts into new weapons and armour, solo or in four-player squads.

ff7-rebirth.desc: The second part of the Final Fantasy VII remake trilogy, opening up the world beyond Midgar with hybrid action-command combat.

kcd2.desc: A grounded medieval RPG in 15th-century Bohemia, with realistic swordplay, reputation systems and no fantasy elements.

avowed.desc: A first-person fantasy RPG in the Pillars of Eternity setting, mixing spells, guns and blades with companion-driven quests.

metaphor.desc: A turn-based fantasy RPG from the Persona team, built around archetypes, a travelling party and a race for the throne.

persona-3-reload.desc: A full remake of Persona 3: balance high-school life by day with turn-based dungeon crawling during the Dark Hour.

lies-of-p.desc: A soulslike RPG retelling Pinocchio in a fallen belle époque city, with weapon assembly and a lie-driven narrative.

black-myth-wukong.desc: An action RPG based on Journey to the West, with staff combat, transformations and spectacular boss encounters.

stalker-2.desc: An open-world survival shooter in the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone, with anomalies, mutants and scarce supplies.

indiana-jones.desc: A first-person 1930s adventure of puzzles, stealth and improvised fistfights across globe-spanning dig sites.

gta-v.desc: Three criminals, one city: an open-world crime story in Los Santos with heists, plus access to the online mode.

mk1.desc: A rebooted Mortal Kombat timeline with tag-in Kameo fighters, a cinematic story mode and the series' signature finishers.

tekken-8.desc: 3D fighting with an aggressive Heat system, a large roster and extensive single-player and online modes.

sf6.desc: Street Fighter with the Drive system, modern simplified controls and the open-world-styled World Tour mode.

no-mans-sky.desc: Space exploration and survival across a procedurally generated galaxy, expanded for years with free updates.

hollow-knight-silksong.desc: The Hollow Knight sequel starring Hornet, with faster acrobatic combat and a huge hand-drawn kingdom to explore.

balatro.desc: A poker-shaped roguelike deckbuilder where jokers stack into absurd scoring combinations run after run.

cult-of-the-lamb.desc: Build and manage a cult between roguelike dungeon runs, combining base management with fast top-down combat.

palworld.desc: Open-world survival crafting where captured creatures fight beside you and work your base and factories.

r6-siege-x.desc: Tactical 5v5 shooter built on destructible walls, gadgets and attacker-versus-defender operator picks.

stardew-valley.desc: Inherit a run-down farm and rebuild it: crops, animals, fishing, mining and a town full of characters to know.

subnautica.desc: Underwater survival on an alien ocean planet, scavenging wrecks, building bases and diving into darker depths.

sons-of-the-forest.desc: Open-world survival horror on a cannibal-infested island, with base building, seasons and co-op play.

ready-or-not.desc: A deliberate, tense tactical police shooter about clearing hostile locations with a small SWAT team.

hades-2.desc: The sequel to Hades: a fast isometric roguelike where Melinoë fights through the underworld with boons and weapon builds.
